--src: Mathlib.NumberTheory.LucasLehmer
theorem sModNat_eq_sMod (p k : ℕ) (hp : 2 ≤ p) : (sModNat (2 ^ p - 1) k : ℤ) = sMod p k := by
  have h1 := calc
    4 = 2 ^ 2 := by norm_num
    _ ≤ 2 ^ p := Nat.pow_le_pow_of_le_right (by norm_num) hp
  have h2 : 1 ≤ 2 ^ p := by omega
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    rw [sModNat, sMod, Int.ofNat_emod]
    simp [h2]
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [sModNat, sMod, ← ih]
    have h3 : 2 ≤ 2 ^ p - 1 := by
      zify [h2]
      calc
        (2 : Int) ≤ 4 - 1 := by norm_num
        _         ≤ 2 ^ p - 1 := by zify at h1; exact Int.sub_le_sub_right h1 _
    zify [h2, h3]
    rw [← add_sub_assoc, sub_eq_add_neg, add_assoc, add_comm _ (-2), ← add_assoc,
      Int.add_emod_self, ← sub_eq_add_neg]

--src: Mathlib.NumberTheory.LucasLehmer
theorem order_ineq (p' : ℕ) (h : lucasLehmerResidue (p' + 2) = 0) :
    2 ^ (p' + 2) < (q (p' + 2) : ℕ) ^ 2 :=
  calc
    2 ^ (p' + 2) = orderOf (ωUnit (p' + 2)) := (order_ω p' h).symm
    _ ≤ Fintype.card (X (q (p' + 2)))ˣ := orderOf_le_card_univ
    _ < (q (p' + 2) : ℕ) ^ 2 := card_units_lt (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt (two_lt_q _))

--src: Mathlib.Data.Nat.Prime.Basic
theorem Prime.eq_two_or_odd {p : ℕ} (hp : Prime p) : p = 2 ∨ p % 2 = 1 :=
  p.mod_two_eq_zero_or_one.imp_left fun h =>
    ((hp.eq_one_or_self_of_dvd 2 (dvd_of_mod_eq_zero h)).resolve_left (by decide)).symm

--src: Mathlib.Data.Nat.Totient
theorem totient_even {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 < n) : Even n.totient := by
  haveI : Fact (1 < n) := ⟨one_lt_two.trans hn⟩
  haveI : NeZero n := NeZero.of_gt hn
  suffices 2 = orderOf (-1 : (ZMod n)ˣ) by
    rw [← ZMod.card_units_eq_totient, even_iff_two_dvd, this]
    exact orderOf_dvd_card
  rw [← orderOf_units, Units.coe_neg_one, orderOf_neg_one, ringChar.eq (ZMod n) n, if_neg hn.ne']

--src: Mathlib.Algebra.Group.Nat.Even
theorem one_lt_of_ne_zero_of_even (h0 : n ≠ 0) (hn : Even n) : 1 < n := by
  refine Nat.one_lt_iff_ne_zero_and_ne_one.mpr (And.intro h0 ?_)
  intro h
  rw [h] at hn
  exact Nat.not_even_one hn

--src: Mathlib.Data.Nat.Defs
protected lemma pow_lt_pow_left (h : a < b) : ∀ {n : ℕ}, n ≠ 0 → a ^ n < b ^ n
  | 1, _ => by simpa
  | n + 2, _ => Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_lt_of_le (Nat.pow_lt_pow_left h n.succ_ne_zero) (Nat.le_of_lt h)
    (zero_lt_of_lt h)

/-- For finsets of naturals, the colexicographic order is equivalent to the order induced by the
`n`-ary expansion. -/
lemma geomSum_lt_geomSum_iff_toColex_lt_toColex (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    ∑ i ∈ s, n ^ i < ∑ i ∈ t, n ^ i ↔ toColex s < toColex t :=
  (geomSum_ofColex_strictMono hn).lt_iff_lt

--src: Mathlib.Data.List.NodupEquivFin
theorem get_strictMono (h : l.Sorted (· < ·)) : StrictMono l.get := fun _ _ => h.rel_get_of_lt

--src: Mathlib.Data.Nat.ModEq
theorem add_mod_of_add_mod_lt {a b c : ℕ} (hc : a % c + b % c < c) :
    (a + b) % c = a % c + b % c := by rw [← add_mod_add_ite, if_neg (not_le_of_lt hc), add_zero]

--src: Mathlib.NumberTheory.LegendreSymbol.ZModChar
/-- The value of `χ₄ n`, for `n : ℕ`, depends only on `n % 4`. -/
theorem χ₄_nat_mod_four (n : ℕ) : χ₄ n = χ₄ (n % 4 : ℕ) := by
  rw [← ZMod.natCast_mod n 4]

--src: Mathlib.NumberTheory.LucasLehmer
theorem ω_pow_eq_one (p' : ℕ) (h : lucasLehmerResidue (p' + 2) = 0) :
    (ω : X (q (p' + 2))) ^ 2 ^ (p' + 2) = 1 :=
  calc
    (ω : X (q (p' + 2))) ^ 2 ^ (p' + 2) = (ω ^ 2 ^ (p' + 1)) ^ 2 := by
      rw [← pow_mul, ← Nat.pow_succ]
    _ = (-1) ^ 2 := by rw [ω_pow_eq_neg_one p' h]
    _ = 1 := by simp

--src: Mathlib.NumberTheory.LucasLehmer
theorem sModNatTR_eq_sModNat (q : ℕ) (i : ℕ) : sModNatTR q i = sModNat q i := by
  rw [sModNatTR, helper, sModNat_aux_eq]
where
  helper b q k : sModNatTR.go q k b = sModNat_aux b q k := by
    induction k generalizing b with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ k ih =>
      rw [sModNatTR.go, ih, sModNat_aux]
      clear ih
      induction k with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ k ih =>
        rw [sModNat_aux, ih, sModNat_aux]

--src: Mathlib.NumberTheory.LucasLehmer
theorem sMod_nonneg (p : ℕ) (hp : p ≠ 0) (i : ℕ) : 0 ≤ sMod p i := by
  cases i <;> dsimp [sMod]
  · exact sup_eq_right.mp rfl
  · apply Int.emod_nonneg
    exact mersenne_int_ne_zero p hp

--src: Mathlib.Data.ZMod.Basic
instance charP (n : ℕ) : CharP (ZMod n) n where
  cast_eq_zero_iff' := by
    intro k
    cases' n with n
    · simp [zero_dvd_iff, Int.natCast_eq_zero]
    · exact Fin.natCast_eq_zero

--src: Mathlib.NumberTheory.LucasLehmer
theorem sMod_lt (p : ℕ) (hp : p ≠ 0) (i : ℕ) : sMod p i < 2 ^ p - 1 := by
  rw [← sMod_mod]
  refine (Int.emod_lt _ (mersenne_int_ne_zero p hp)).trans_eq ?_
  exact abs_of_nonneg (mersenne_int_pos hp).le
